collectorNotes:
I checked these sources on 2026-10-12: the Anthropic launch page (headline table plus the chart aria-labels for each effort level), the Opus 5.5 system card (230 pages, text extracted and the figure pages viewed as images), and the Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 system cards.

Four columns have no comparable vendor or third-party score: SciCode, CritPt, GDP.pdf and AA-LCR. Anthropic does not report them, and Artificial Analysis numbers are already in the dataset.

Benchmark-author leaderboards:
- tbench.ai TB4: 64.85 (max, Claude Code).
- frontierswe.com: 62.3.
- Zapier: 42.47 (Max) and 35.77 (XHigh), both with default fallbacks.
- Snorkel ALE: Score 63.2 / Pass 38.2.
- Not listed on DeepSWE (Datacurve, snapshot updated 2026-09-22), the Toolathlon homepage preview, the Scale HLE boards or the osworld-v2 site.
- The tbench Terminal-Bench-Science board and agents-last-exam.org render client-side, so I could not read them.

OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch page returns 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so none of the Opus 5.5 numbers the leads attribute to it are verified: GDP.pdf 25.6–28.8, TB-Science 63.3, and the AutomationBench sweep. The leads' source is an alphacorp.ai repost, and the secondary blogs disagree with each other. One OpenAI forum chart does plot "Opus 5.5 w/ fallbacks" on AutomationBench, but it has no data labels, so I did not record it.

Anthropic's own numbers that repeat on the Sonnet/Haiku launch pages and cards are not recorded again.

Caveats:
- OSWorld: the launch page says 2.1 while the system card says 2.0 (task files dated Sept 10, 2026).
- TB4: the headline is at xhigh; max is 64.8.
- FrontierCode: the best Main score is at medium (54.6); the max-effort score is 54.4.
- GDPval-AA: Elo was converted as (Elo−500)/2000×100.
verifierSummary: I checked all 50 records against the live sources and confirmed every one; no score needed correcting. Sources opened: the Anthropic launch page (raw HTML, including the chart aria-labels, the benchmark table and its footnotes); the Opus 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 system card PDFs (text extracted, with pages 185-186 rendered to read the HLE figure labels); and the leaderboards at tbench.ai TB 4.0, Vals AI Terminal-Bench 4.0 and Terminal-Bench Science, frontierswe.com, zapier.com/benchmarks and the Snorkel Agents' Last Exam board. Verbatim confirmations: the TB4 effort points 38.5/57.6/64.2/66.4/64.8; FrontierCode 47.3/54.6/54.0/51.4/54.4 (Extended 63.6 at max, 65.3 at medium); AutomationBench 23.3/28.6/32.0/34.4/40.0; GDPval-AA Elo 1224/1576/1692/1820/1846, which convert to 36.2/53.8/59.6/66.0/67.3; HLE with tools 57.4/63.0/63.9/66.4/67.7 and without tools 52.9/59.0/59.6/62.8/64.4; the tbench.ai JSON shows accuracy 64.85, n_trials 330, reasoning_effort max; Vals shows 65.15% and the fallback note '22 of 198 ... lowers it from 65.15% to 58.08%' (58.08% is coincidentally also Fable 5.1's score on that table, but the note ties this 58.08 to Opus 5.5); Vals TB-Science v0.1 shows 47.14%; FrontierSWE V2 shows 62.3% ± 9.8 (worst 52.0, best 71.5); Zapier 1.0.6 shows 42.47% and 35.77% and states that leaderboard scores use the held-out private set; Snorkel Overall shows Pass Rate 38.2% and Score 63.2%. The system card confirms DeepSWE v1.1 at 74.2% average over five trials, OSWorld 2.0 at 81.8 partial / 48.7 strict on 108 tasks, and Toolathlon-Verified at 77.8/82.4/72.2 from an internal harness. The Haiku card confirms the offline subset (82 of 108 tasks) at 87.2/53.2, and the Sonnet card confirms 42.5 with re-run fallbacks versus 40.0 without. The comparability flags all follow the column rules. Points to note: the launch page labels the benchmark OSWorld 2.1 while the system card calls it OSWorld 2.0 (September 10, 2026 task files), and the record already says so. TB4 has three records marked matchesPreferred=true (Anthropic xhigh, Anthropic max, and the tbench.ai max run); the column rules allow this, but downstream code should choose only one as primary.
